task_text: Grab the tray by both handles -- the left gripper on one handle bar, the right gripper on the other -- and keep the ball on the tray. The moment both handle bars are touched by the fingers (one arm's fingers on each bar), an 11-second countdown starts and the ball gets a push every 0.5 s (a 0.1 s force in the tray's plane, up to ~0.18 m/s each, its direction drifting from push to push). Success: the countdown completes with the ball on the tray throughout and both handles held throughout (each bar touched by its arm's fingers within the last 0.1 s at every control step). Failure, which ends the episode: the ball leaves the tray (its centre outside the tray floor's central ~0.26 x 0.25 m area, or lower than 8 mm above the floor), or a handle is let go during the countdown.
